user_task: How many songs are in my Spotify library?

task_history.content: How many songs are in my Spotify library?

```python
login = apis.spotify.login(account_number='1234567890', username='user@example.com', password='pass123')
token = login['access_token']
playlists = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token)
song_count = sum(len(p.get('songs', [])) for p in playlists)
print(f'You have {song_count} songs')
```
You have 150 songs in your Spotify library.
